description: This file contains implementation details for HIP9011 sensor lookup tables, including constants for integrator values, gain values, frequency bands, and functions related to RPM calculation, band index retrieval, and engine noise table initialization.

methods.name: getRpmByAngleWindowAndTimeUs
methods.description: Calculates RPM based on angle window width and time in microseconds.

methods.name: getHip9011BandIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a frequency within the band frequency lookup array.

methods.name: initEngineNoiseTable
methods.description: Initializes engine noise lookup table with predefined values.
